visuals.purpose: 为引言建立大规模并行的视觉氛围
visuals.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: Chinese HPC tutorial chapter-opening decorative illustration
Primary request: an abstract visual metaphor for massively parallel GPU work, shown as many small luminous tiles moving in coordinated waves toward a central field of computation
Scene/backdrop: clean deep navy technical atmosphere with subtle grid depth
Subject: abstract light tiles and flowing paths only, no literal chip diagram
Style/medium: polished editorial 3D illustration, restrained and sophisticated
Composition/framing: wide landscape, strong central rhythm, generous clean margins
Lighting/mood: cool cyan and warm amber accents, calm sense of scale and coordination
Constraints: decorative only; no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no recognizable GPU product, no circuit labels, no technical architecture claims
Avoid: infographic layout, arrows with semantic meaning, branded hardware, dense clutter
